title: Import
dialogHint: Import creates a new project from an AT5 or GEDCOM file. The source file is never modified.
chooseFileCta: Choose a file or drop it here
chooseMediaCta: Choose a folder or drop it here
fileHint: AT5 or GEDCOM — the type is detected automatically.
mediaHint: Optional. Searched next to the data file first, then in this folder.
unsupportedFile: Only AT5 and GEDCOM (.ged) files are supported.
pickFileTitle: Choose an AT5 or GEDCOM file
intro: AT5 import creates a new project from the database file. The source file is opened read-only and is never modified.
gedcomIntro: GEDCOM import creates a new project from a .ged file. The file is read-only, and the media files it resolves are copied into the project.
empty: Choose an .at5 file: existing projects are never overwritten and AT5 import only reads the source.
gedcomEmpty: Choose a .ged file: existing projects are never overwritten and import only reads the source.
mediaDirsHint: Add folders with photos and documents. Import looks next to the data file first, then in the added folders; any folder, including .files folders, can be added.
noMediaDirs: No extra folders added: only folders next to the data file are searched.
mediaNotice: Found media files are copied into the project on import.
mediaCopiedNotice: Media files are copied into the project on import.
